newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH OFFICIAL RESERVES UP TO $18.45 BLN IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: POLISH OFFICIAL RESERVES UP TO $18.45 BLN IN APRIL.

text.p: currency reserves grew by $472 million in April to $18.449
billion and were $1.053 billion higher than a year ago, the
National Bank of Poland said on Wednesday.
Official reserves grew $416 million in the January-April
period compared to a $2.433 billion rise in the corresponding
POLISH RESERVES (bln dlrs) APRIL MARCH APRIL 96
NOTE - Figures in billions of dollars. Official reserves
are those held by the state. Net reserves mean the total amount
of hard currencies in the whole banking system.
